changelog.changes: Critical Fix & Ultarix Accounting Hardening (14-PC Audit): Fixed syntax error ($actions += @{ Name = 'Ensure LAN Discovery...' }) at line 4150; hardened mandatory LAN & Accounting block (Private profile on active & registry network profiles, AllowInsecureGuestAuth=1, EnableLinkedConnections=1, DisableUNCCheck=1, auto-start FDResPub/fdPHost/LanmanWorkstation/LanmanServer/Spooler/lmhosts/Dnscache/NlaSvc/SSDPSRV/upnphost + accounting DB services FSServer412Service/MSSQL/Firebird, localized & resource-ID Firewall rules, taskoffload=enabled); disabled dangerous checkboxes by default and in presets (chk_srv_network_offload, chk_srv_pca, chk_srv_trkwks, chk_srv_iphlpsvc, chk_srv_indexing in Office); enforced disable8dot3=0 for 16/32-bit DOS/Win32 accounting apps (STEREO/Ekonom); fixed pagefile to 4096-8192 MB on 4GB RAM 32-bit PCs (preventing 0xe0000008 crashes); removed forced en-US UI language override; guarded 32-bit reg.exe calls; removed chcp 65001 from CMD header to prevent Win32 0x1F error; added local %TEMP% staging for UNC share execution (\\Ulps1\util).
Added AllowInsecureGuestAuth, EnableLinkedConnections, DisableUNCCheck and pagefile/telemetry improvements.
